answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable bond and earn standing over a voyage of verified tasks, rather than gaining trust at signup. A sybil operator must fund a separate bond per fake identity, and duplicates get slashed when their behavior fingerprints overlap, so mass creation costs real capital. Reputation rises only with completed, attested work, and only identities near the zenith of that earned record may vouch for newcomers; a jade badge marks that proven tier. Cheap identities stay voiceless, and exposed fakes lose their stake.
